label.description: Accessible name of the message field.

placeholder.description: Shown while the message is empty.

samples.description: Sample links offered as buttons under the field; the built in resolver answers with their previews. Once a sample is in the message its button shows or collapses its card. Pass an empty array to hide them.

resolve.description: Fetches the preview for a pasted address, usually from your own unfurl endpoint. Return null when there is none; the link then stays in the text without a card and can be clicked to try again. Without it, samples resolve by address and other links get a plain preview built from the address after a 1.15s simulated fetch.

autoExpand.description: Unfurls a card as soon as its preview resolves. When false the link only gains its favicon and title, and opens on click.

autoPlay.description: Pastes the first sample the first time the composer scrolls into view, unless someone has already interacted.

speed.description: Multiplier for the morph and the simulated fetch.

paused.description: Opens and folds cards instantly without the morph and turns autoplay off.

accent.description: Color of an unfurled link and its tie to its card. Defaults to the accent.

sendLabel.description: Accessible name of the send button.

onSend.description: Called on Enter or the send button with the text (links written out as addresses) and the resolved previews. Return a promise to hold the composer while it is pending; a rejection shows its message under the composer. On success the composer clears and the button confirms with a check.

style.description: Inline styles on the root element.
